surface_fidelity: production web entrypoint; isolated namespace; object lifecycle unchanged
persona: First-time user who wants to save one note and find it after returning
goal: Create one note, leave, and find the same note again

steps.observation: Home shows Notes (0) and a New button
steps.result: editor opens with an empty title

steps.action: open New, enter milk, and save

steps.result: Home still shows Notes (2), including milk

findings.title: Leaving an empty editor creates an Untitled note
findings.claim: Entering the editor and leaving without input adds a visible object
findings.visible_evidence: The visible count changed from 0 to 1 after step 2
findings.impact: Users collect notes they did not intend to create
findings.inference: Automatic drafts may be intentional; the controller must compare the product's draft contract

unknowns: Whether a native process relaunch preserves the same objects

reset_receipt.method: fresh browser context and isolated namespace
